originalScenario.disposition: Prior accepted scenario and its first 11-case evidence are unchanged. This is additional ubiquitous EARS evidence, not a new scenario.

protectedExecution.actualInnerCommands: Exact compiler and Node argv, outputs and exits are preserved in observations.json.

sourceTuple.sourceHashes: Complete executed source snapshot is preserved in observations.json. All 100 entries were independently rehashed at integration with no changed or missing file.

observed: Actual compiled Elm worker input/output ports and JavaScript JSON traverse production PreviewLifecycle scopeDecoder and eventDecoder, init and update for Open, Request and Clock, then encodeCommands.
Four large-string positive cases preserve exact adjacent deadline strings in complete Acquire jobs; synthetic policy pairs use now plus 2000000000 nanoseconds.
Equal and expired deadlines emit no Acquire. A matching clock reaching the original deadline emits Cancel with the same complete job.
A coherent canonical-string negative baseline actually emits Acquire. Each of 31 numeric cases changes one field and is rejected at the expected production decoder stage with no commands.
